title: Camera Check
description: Read-only check: does this car's front camera send its traffic light, its light sources for the high beam, its object lists, its sign lists and its lanes? Each row says whether it is an event (silent until something happens) or a field (its getter must answer at once), with the provider's ups and downs, the getter's answer and the number of messages; a control row shows the speed and rpm the themes receive, and the top line the app's own clock, the speed and the vehicle condition. A cruise row shows whether a unit answers the multimodal driver-assistance service (its DCC and SLD states, the set speed). The first message of each source is written to the log. Writes nothing to the car.

de.bmw.environmentalmodel.TrafficLightRe._about: The camera's traffic light (event 32769): id, x / y / z, status, arrow, direction, colour, quality. Never seen on the car.

de.bmw.sensors.objects.RecogFrontCameraL._about: The camera's light sources for automatic high beam (events 32769, 32770) and its own high-beam verdict (32790). acknowledgeObjectData* (setter, no getter) are NOT declared. Never seen on the car.

de.bmw.sensors.objects.RecogFrontCameraO._about: The camera's object list, up to 20, with head / rear lamp state per object (event 32770). The fallback for the high beam.

de.bmw.environmentalmodel.ObjectRecognit._about: The camera's objects: class, lane, id (event 32769).

de.bmw.environmentalmodel.SignRecognitio._about: The camera's sign lists, older form (events 32769, 32770). A 40 km/h limit was seen in one of the sign lists on 2026-11-19.

de.bmw.dass.TrafficSignRecognition._about: The speed limit and no overtaking (event 32769). Seen on the car: the control source that proves the app hears the camera's side at all.

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.Vehicle2._about: statusLightStatus (getter 43, notifier 32811): high beam / dipped beam as the car reports them. statusCarSpeed2 (getter 8, notifier 32776): our speed, on the top line and in the control row (the themes receive it on this car). Read only.

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.CDS._about: fix-1121 CS, the control row: the engine speed (getter 25, notifier 32793), declared as the themes declare it (kit/car.js 'rpm'); sent all the time while the engine runs. Read only.

de.bmw.infrastructure.VehicleCondition._about: fix-1121 CS, the control row and the top line: the vehicle condition (notifier 32769, no getter; 10 = FAHREN), declared as Twin Dial declares it. Read only.

de.bmw.body.Light._about: The body controller's lamp commands, among them the main beam (notifier 32772, no getter). Read only.

de.bmw.infotainment.fasus.FASuS._about: The driver-assistance functions' state, among them the traffic-light functions (getter 51, notifier 32819). Read only.

de.bmw.dass.driverassistanceapplications._about: 0.1.3 cruise CR (rung 2, docs/fixes-1121/CC-REPORT.md §7.4): the multimodal driver-assistance service's availability (service 13203, getter 2, notifier 32769): the ACC / SLA / SLD / DCC states and valueSetSpeed. A value means a unit on this car answers the service. The setter the multimodal write-only field is NOT declared. Read only.

config._rows: fix-1121 CS: «подія» rows are events (silent until something happens: normal while parked); «поле» rows are fields (the getter must answer at once, parked too; no answer = a fault). S_CTRL: the speed, the rpm and the vehicle condition, which the themes receive on this car: if it stays silent too, the app hears nothing.
